body:
All fixes applied and verified. Typecheck clean.

**BlogCard.tsx** — nested anchors fixed via stretched-link pattern:
- Outer `<a>` → `<div className="relative block p-6 bg-surface ...">` (same visual classes, added `relative`)
- New inner `<a href={postUrl} className="after:absolute after:inset-0 z-10">` wraps date, title, excerpt — stretches over entire card
- Tags container gets `relative z-20 flex flex-wrap gap-2` — sits above stretched link, remains clickable
- No nested anchors remain. Two `<a>` tags now siblings, not parent/child.

**Footer.tsx** — 4 fixes:
1. YouTube link removed from `links` array (line ~17)
2. Tagline: "Music producer." removed → "Self-taught software engineer. Founder. From Guyana."
3. Links container: `flex gap-6` → `flex flex-wrap gap-6` (prevents overflow on narrow widths)
4. Contrast: `text-muted/50` → `text-muted` on "Built with Astro + React + Three.js" line (#9a9a9a on #0a0a0a ≈ 7.6:1, passes WCAG AA)

`npx tsc --noEmit` passes with no errors. No other files touched.
